name: saved-views
title: SavedViews
description: Saved views for the filter model: useSavedViews (apply as one undo step, save, save as, rename, delete through your persistence callbacks, optimistic until your views catch up with rollback on rejected promises, a dirty flag that ignores ids and chips without values, a diff, and migration of views saved with older schemas) and SavedViewsMenu, a popover grouped by personal and team scope with inline rename, confirmed delete and a save-as form.
